cases.input: Alternatives A and B reference the same pinned WM-KNW-015 Opportunity but carry different forecasts and risk sets.
cases.expect: The external Opportunity identity is retained while release-local option forecasts remain separate and are never summed.

cases.input: BC-1 pins criteria C-v2, baseline, horizon and price base; D-1 selects A and REC-1 records the rationale.
cases.expect: The original decision is reproducible from its immutable input package.

cases.input: B1 forecast changes after D-1.
cases.expect: BC-2 is created and review may trigger without rewriting BC-1, D-1 or REC-1.

cases.input: Alternative A is reappraised in BC-2 after BC-1 was issued.
cases.expect: A keeps its Initiative-scoped option identity while BC-2 carries new appraisal values and BC-1 remains immutable.

cases.input: REC-1 issues D-1 using pinned rationale, occurrence, BC-1, risk, assumption, hypothesis and budget revisions.
cases.expect: REC-1 freezes the complete join so the decision graph is reproducible as-of issue time.

cases.input: REC-1 binds WM-ECO-012 revision BUD-v3 at state kind available.
cases.expect: Both the pinned budget revision and exact funding state kind are frozen in the decision join.

cases.input: Initiative I is rejected at gate G using BC-1.
cases.expect: A WM-REC-010 rejection record freezes the same case, rationale, occurrence and external revision join used for approval.

cases.input: An initiative is rejected at a gate.
cases.expect: It is retained with alternatives, evidence and rationale and no delivery identity is created.

cases.input: A tracker ticket automatically becomes a Project.
cases.expect: The identity transition is rejected without separate authorization and typed derivation.

cases.input: Investment approval is treated as proof that benefit B1 was realized.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected.

cases.input: The selected option and criteria in BC-1 are overwritten after decision.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; a successor Business Case release is required.

cases.input: REC-1 refers to the current Assumption, Hypothesis, Risk or Budget record without revision pins.
cases.expect: Issuance is rejected because as-of reconstruction would depend on mutable live state.

cases.input: The Initiative copies a shared funding pool into its own authoritative budget facts.
cases.expect: The write is rejected; WM-ECO-012 remains master and Initiative stores pinned references only.

cases.input: A portfolio-wide capital allocation with no single Initiative is forced into EM-STR-04.
cases.expect: The case is rejected from this profile and remains WM-ACT-029-owned.

cases.input: A rejected Initiative and its appraisals are cascade-deleted or its identifier is reused.
cases.expect: Deletion and identity reuse are rejected; the full rejection history remains addressable.

cases.input: Narrative label D-1 is given an allocator and treated as a durable decision aggregate separate from REC-1.
cases.expect: The new identity is rejected; REC-1 is the address and O-1 is the temporal anchor.

cases.input: BC-2 matches an Alternative to BC-1 only by display label.
cases.expect: The rebind is rejected; the Initiative-scoped option key is required.

cases.input: BC-1 and BC-2 reference a shared criteria/pin-set object with no external master or pinned revision.
cases.expect: The hidden aggregate is rejected; pins must be release-local copies or governed external revisions.

cases.input: An as-of decision query follows BC-1's supersession link and returns BC-2.
cases.expect: The traversal is rejected; REC-1 resolves directly to BC-1.

cases.input: After formalization the Initiative becomes master of realized delivery benefits.
cases.expect: The write is rejected; realized benefit is out of profile and mastered by the delivery identity.
